fields.title: Master Data Science with Python
fields.description: **Master Data Science from the ground up with a practical, hands-on approach.** This course covers Python, Statistics, SQL, Data Analysis, Data Visualization, Machine Learning, and AI fundamentals through real-world projects and industry-focused exercises. By the end of the course, you'll have the skills to analyze data, build predictive models, and create a professional portfolio that prepares you for internships and entry-level Data Science roles.

fields.title: Python Fundamentals
fields.text_content: Learn the fundamentals of Python programming, including variables, data types, operators, and user input/output. This lesson builds the programming foundation required for Data Science.

fields.title: Control Flow & Functions
fields.text_content: Understand how to control program execution using conditional statements and loops. Learn to write reusable functions and organize code with Python modules.

fields.title: Data Structures
fields.text_content: Explore Python's core data structures and learn how to efficiently store, manipulate, and access data for real-world applications.

fields.title: NumPy & Pandas
fields.text_content: Learn to work with NumPy arrays and Pandas DataFrames to import, clean, organize, and prepare datasets for analysis.

fields.title: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
fields.text_content: Discover techniques for exploring datasets, handling missing values, generating descriptive statistics, and identifying patterns in data.

fields.title: Introduction to Machine Learning
fields.text_content: Understand the fundamentals of Machine Learning, including supervised and unsupervised learning, common algorithms, and the complete ML workflow.

fields.title: Building Your First Model
fields.text_content: Build your first Machine Learning model by preparing data, training algorithms, making predictions, and using Scikit-learn to solve practical problems.

fields.title: HTML & CSS
fields.text_content: Learn the fundamentals of front-end web development by building structured and visually appealing web pages. This lesson covers HTML for creating webpage structure and CSS for styling layouts, colors, typography, spacing, and responsive designs. By the end of the lesson, you'll be able to create modern, user-friendly web interfaces and understand the foundation of every website.

fields.title: Django Web Development
fields.text_content: Learn how to build powerful, secure, and scalable web applications using the Django framework. This lesson covers project setup, URL routing, views, templates, models, authentication, CRUD operations, and database integration. By the end of the lesson, you'll be able to develop dynamic, database-driven web applications following Django's best practices.
